name: io.github.darrenjrobinson/untappd
description: MCP server exposing Untappd API tools for AI agents — full v4 read API coverage

environmentVariables.description: Untappd OAuth access token — unlocks the friend feed tool, user-scoped rate limits, and richer /user data. Optional: can instead be obtained interactively via the authenticate_untappd tool or `npx untappd-mcp-server auth` (stored in ~/.untappd-mcp-server/token.json)
environmentVariables.name: UNTAPPD_ACCESS_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Default username for authenticated user tools
environmentVariables.name: UNTAPPD_USERNAME

environmentVariables.description: OAuth redirect URL for interactive authentication — must exactly match the Callback URL registered in your Untappd app settings; default http://localhost:8737/callback
environmentVariables.name: UNTAPPD_REDIRECT_URL

environmentVariables.description: Override path for the saved token file; default ~/.untappd-mcp-server/token.json
environmentVariables.name: UNTAPPD_TOKEN_PATH
